items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1962-02-06
items.q: Well Steve came in town and he come out and started playing with us.

ctx.x: Yeah. When did you first meet Steve Lewis?

Well Steve, he used to go on, he traveled with a show called Billy Mack, you know. And we had another boy playing with us called Arthur Campbell. Well Arthur left me, he went to Chicago, see. Well Steve came in town and he come out and started playing with us. Well in Carroll family. Yeah, he stayed with us, yeah. But he used to travel with Billy Mack's show to play these theaters, you know, circuits, like the Lyric and there was different places, you know, around Chicago and Cleveland and things like that to…
Who taught Steve to play? Steve?

items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: That's my brother, Charlie. And that's me there, see? Mm-hmm. That's the same band.

ctx.x: That's my brother, Charlie. And that's me there, see? Mm-hmm. That's the same band.
